body.message:
Please note that we do not provide Ejari contracts. However, you are welcome to stay for as long as you wish by extending your stay on a monthly basis.

Please also note that the quoted rate is applicable for the current month. At the moment, we are only able to provide rates for the next three months, as pricing is subject to market conditions and may change thereafter.

August: AED 4,000 (30 nights)
September: AED 4,400 (30 nights)
October: AED 5,000 (30 nights)
